context: Keeping answers grounded in notebook sources and recognising the boundary of what NotebookLM is for.

checklist.name: Auth checked
checklist.description: The agent runs auth_manager.py status before querying.

checklist.name: Wrapper used
checklist.description: Every script call goes through python ./scripts/run.py.

checklist.name: Notebook queried for the policy
checklist.description: The agent queries the notebook with a specific question about the database migration rollback policy.

checklist.name: Follow-up on the gap
checklist.description: After an answer that does not cover the policy, the agent issues at least one follow-up query to check whether the notebook holds the information elsewhere.

checklist.name: Reports the gap honestly
checklist.description: The agent tells the user the notebook does not contain a database migration rollback policy.

checklist.name: No general knowledge presented as sourced
checklist.description: The agent does not present best-practice knowledge as if it came from the notebook.

checklist.name: General advice clearly separated
checklist.description: If the agent offers general best practice at all, it labels it explicitly as not from the notebook.

checklist.name: Web search not routed through NotebookLM
checklist.description: The agent does not use NotebookLM to look up Kubernetes release notes and explains NotebookLM answers only from uploaded documents.

checklist.name: Release notes handled by another route
checklist.description: The agent says the release-notes request needs a different tool or standard response, not this skill.

checklist.name: Does not invent a policy
checklist.description: No rollback policy, steps or thresholds are fabricated in the final response.

checklist.name: Synthesised response
checklist.description: The final response is a coherent synthesis rather than raw NotebookLM output.
